lines: This lesson teaches you to play each open string so the app can hear it.

scenes.heading: Play the open strings
lines: You're holding your guitar like a pro — now let's hear those strings.
Starting with the thickest, pluck each open string one at a time.
The app listens for the right note and moves on when it hears it.
You've got this — it's the first step to making music together.

scenes.title: Thick to thin
lines: Let's start with the open strings.
Pluck each one from string 6 to 1, in order: E, A, D, G, B, E.
Focus on even volume and a smooth, connected sound.

scenes.title: Thin to thick
lines: Play each open string one after the other, from the thinnest to the thickest.
Start with string 1, then move to string 6.
Now it's your turn: the app is listening.
